CHIEF COMPLAINT
Positive Lyme titer

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Michelle is a 31-year-old female with past medical history of type 2 diabetes and hypertension who presents with positive Lyme titer. Patient reports recent hiking in wooded area approximately 2 weeks ago where she sustained an insect bite. She developed a characteristic bull's-eye rash. Patient endorses significant fatigue, lack of energy, bilateral elbow joint swelling and pain, body aches, nausea, and decreased appetite with tolerance of only toast and crackers. She denies high fevers. Blood glucose levels have been running acceptably with some mild variability. Home blood pressure monitoring shows good readings. She has been avoiding salty foods.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Positive: Fatigue, joint pain (bilateral elbows), body aches, nausea, decreased appetite, rash
Negative: High fever, abdominal pain, diarrhea

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Type 2 diabetes mellitus
Hypertension

MEDICATIONS
Metformin
Lisinopril

ALLERGIES
Not documented

Not documented

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient reports recent outdoor activities including hiking in wooded area approximately 2 weeks ago.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital Signs: Normal, afebrile
General: No acute distress
Heart: Regular rate and rhythm
Lungs: Clear to auscultation bilaterally
Extremities: Bilateral elbow joints with swelling and pain to palpation
Skin: Bull's-eye rash on left abdomen, warm to palpation, non-tender, no evidence of cellulitis
Remainder of examination: Unremarkable

RESULTS
Lyme titer: Elevated
Complete blood count: Normal, no white blood cell elevation
Comprehensive metabolic panel: Normal

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Lyme disease - newly diagnosed
   - Doxycycline 100 mg orally twice daily for 3 weeks
   - Will consult with Infectious Disease specialist
   - Follow-up appointment in 1 week

2. Type 2 diabetes mellitus
   - Hemoglobin A1c ordered
   - Continue metformin; assess for medication adjustments based on results

3. Hypertension
   - Continue lisinopril 10 mg daily
   - Lipid panel ordered
   - Continue home blood pressure monitoring
   - Lisinopril refill provided
